# Pierson Digital

> Pierson Digital is a full-service digital marketing agency — SEO, Meta Ads, custom websites, and CRM & automation — serving businesses nationwide across all industries. No contracts, month-to-month, results-focused. Based in Champaign, Illinois, serving all 50 states.

## Founder
Dylan Pierson

## What Pierson Digital does
- SEO — page-1 rankings with a FREE custom website included: on-page & technical SEO, local SEO & Google Business Profile, monthly content strategy, backlink building, and monthly rankings reports
- Meta Ads — Facebook & Instagram campaigns that convert: audience research & targeting, ad creative & copywriting, A/B testing, and weekly performance reports
- Custom Websites — lead-generating sites live in 5–7 days: custom design & development, SEO-optimized structure, mobile-first & fast, hosting & maintenance
- CRM & Automation — automate follow-up and close more deals: missed-call text-back, AI chat widget 24/7, Google review automation, full CRM on your phone, and pipeline management (trusted by 10,000+ companies)
- The Full Growth System — a bundle combining SEO + Meta Ads + Website + CRM with a dedicated account manager

## Who it's for
Businesses nationwide, across all industries. Pierson Digital works with companies in all 50 states.

## Pricing
- SEO — $997/mo (regularly $1,497): page-1 rankings + FREE custom website included
- Meta Ads — $997/mo (regularly $1,497): Facebook & Instagram leads that convert
- Custom Websites — $97/mo or $1,000 outright: custom sites built to generate leads, live in 5–7 days
- CRM & Automation — $297/mo (+ one-time $750 startup fee): automate follow-up and close more deals
- The Full Growth System — $2,000/mo (regularly $2,388/mo separately, save $388/mo): SEO + Meta Ads + Website + CRM
No contracts, month-to-month, cancel anytime. SEO results typically show in 60–90 days.
